**Lower bound.** By the triangle inequality, $AP \ge AC - CP$ and $BP \ge BC - CP$. Multiplying the second by 2 and adding:

$$AP + 2BP + 3CP \ge (AC - CP) + 2(BC - CP) + 3CP = AC + 2BC.$$

**Equality.** Taking $P = C$ gives $AP + 2BP + 3CP = AC + 2BC$, so the bound is attained.

**Value.** With $AC = 2022$ and $BC = 2023$:

$$AC + 2BC = 2022 + 4046 = 6068.$$
